verdict.rationale: Microsoft's OneDrive docs state that OneDrive enables real-time coauthoring in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, which covers live co-editing of docs, sheets, and slides through a documented first-party integration. The evidence does not say this co-editing happens in the browser, gives no depth on how it works, and nothing in the pack independently confirms or contradicts it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-browser (web) co-editing, details on coauthoring behavior or limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, documents are editable in place — real-time co-editing of docs/sheets/slides in the browser, native or via a documented integration

citations.quote: OneDrive enables real-time coauthoring in familiar apps like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

OneDrive users can access their files from any device, online or offline, and share files with people inside or outside their organization. OneDrive enables real-time coauthoring in familiar apps like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
